ruling_basis: Ryan 2026-09-25: more uncertainty in IR is acceptable, especially where the literature hit the same wall; do the best we can and post results.
Ryan 2026-09-25: Kitt Peak will not be used on future target stars; CRIRES+ and HARPS are the instruments that matter going forward.

primary.why: the band the modern 3D reference analysis actually uses (Amarsi 2021, 59 lines); both holdings sit inside it and CRIRES+ J is telluric-verified
primary.known_systematic: the IAG fit is START-DEPENDENT at 0.225 dex: two runs of the same diagnostic on the same holding land 7.941 and 7.716 while the declared C/O anchor change predicts only -0.033. The chi2 surface is shallow. This bounds `measurement`; it is not hidden in sigma_fit, which reads 0.016-0.037.

secondary.why: in the reference band and retained for the solar zero point, but Kitt Peak is not carried to target stars (Ryan's ruling). It reads +0.257 dex above IAG on the identical diagnostic, molecule and band.

rejected.why: HARPS spans 3780-6910 A and physically cannot reach the reference CN A-X (0-0) band at 10875-13208 A, so this is an instrument limit, not a fixable fit. Its single one-sided continuum leg moves A by 0.849 dex and its frac_rise_weaker is 4.4e-05, three orders below the pack -- a flat chi2 surface. It also carries the 2.404 dex target-Sun difference.

Amarsi 2021 explicitly does not retain NH UV electronic lines (its NH is X-X vibration-rotation at 2.9-15 um). Spite 2022 measured a 0.44-0.52 dex spread from line-list choice alone over 3357-3365 A. Our own near-UV opacity deficit (RYA-1189/1190/1204/1207) sits on top of that, and this route's frac_rise_weaker is 10.29, two orders above the pack.
rejected.retain_as: diagnostic only; upper bound at best

CO_K.status: RETAINED with a large model term
CO_K.note: model_atmosphere 0.140 dex -- the largest of any molecule, because CO's published 1D->3D shift is -0.140. Expected, not a defect.

OH_H.note: +0.758 dex above the reference and edge_distance 0.48, the closest to the grid edge of any route. Retained and reported, not promoted.

atomic_N.why_rejected: CN-blended at 0.67 and 0.75 of their own central depth. Using CN-blended N I lines to adjudicate N I against CN is circular.

irreducible.note: AGSS21 itself reports atomic 7.77 against molecular 7.90 and recommends 7.83 +/- 0.07. The tension is in the published literature, not introduced by us, and no reconciliation should be expected to close below it.

what_is_publishable_now: The atomic N I route (3 clean lines) and the CN A-X NIR molecular route on CRIRES+ J and IAG, each reported with the measured bounds in molecular_route_budgets.json including the 0.225 dex start-dependence. CN_red and NH_AX are diagnostic-only. No route is promoted past its evidence, and none is held for a component the repo can already price.
